visual.general_description: Series of five coronal whole-body PSMA PET maximum-intensity-projection images from one patient during 177Lu-PSMA therapy.
visual.detailed_description: Five coronal whole-body maximum-intensity-projection PET images are arranged side by side on a white background in blue-gray tones. The leftmost image shows many dark discrete foci scattered across the spine, ribs, shoulder regions and pelvis, with dark kidneys and a dark bladder region. The second image shows far fewer faint foci with dark kidneys and a grey liver. The third to fifth images show little or no discrete skeletal foci; kidneys remain dark in each, the liver is a grey area that looks darker in the fourth and fifth images, and in the third and fourth images the arms are raised above the head. No printed text, labels, dates, patient names or scales are visible on the image.
